summary: D007 made traversal formally real: selected final-word lengths routed into omitted candidates. But the traversal sentence still behaved like a caption, and the surface kept too many project-attractor words around route, display, machine, and elsewhere.
strengths: The branch lattice, selector vector, state switch, and ergodic traversal all validated.
The form moved beyond appended receipts toward a surface that performs addressing.
The TRAVERSE acrostic and route state remained mechanically stable.
failure_modes: The route sentence was grammatically flat and too close to a validator summary.
The selected surface still sounded like P0001 apparatus rather than a poem under pressure.
The reader could inspect the route without being instructed to re-enter it.
revision_decision: Revise into D008 Recursive Zero Route: force every selected final word to be three letters long so modulo-three routing always chooses omitted index 0; make the route sentence a recursive command, not a caption.
quality_claim: No quality promotion. This is a cold craft diagnosis only.
